verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud has official JS/TS, Python and Rust SDKs, but its own docs say the Cloud REST APIs are private and limited to authorized users. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, and nothing shows the programmatic surface matches the dashboard/UI. missing for 10: public REST API, published OpenAPI/API reference, documented UI-to-API parity (project, data source and collection management via API), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Orama Cloud officially supports the following SDKs: - JavaScript/TypeScript - Python - Rust
The APIs are designed to be as close as possible to the Orama Cloud APIs, so you can easily migrate your projects from Orama Cloud to Orama Open Source and vice-versa.
